comments.content: [medium] The third argument being passed to `$$render` for alternate branches doesn't match the runtime if_block contract: that function expects either a [number, number] tuple for elseif cases or no third argument at all for regular cases. `b.literal(false)` fits neither shape and could lead to problems at runtime.

[medium] Possible runtime/type failure here: the result of `context.visit(alt)` is assumed to be a `BlockStatement`, and `.body.unshift(...)` is invoked on it with no check. If `alt` ever visits to something that isn't a `BlockStatement`, this will throw. It would be safer to normalize the node into a block (`b.block([stmt])`) when it isn't already a `BlockStatement`, or to rely on an upstream guarantee that's made explicit via an assertion.
[medium] Checking `hydrate_index` with `isNaN` right after the `parseInt` call reads as a code smell; `hydrate_index !== hydrate_index` would be a more dependable way to detect NaN here.
[low] In `IfBlock.js`, add a boundary test for `context.visit(alt)` with the smallest valid input.
[low] Consider giving `isNaN` a named helper if future changes add another branch here.
